sources.title: GitHub - VincyJovitha01/Image-Classification-using-Resnet18
sources.snippet: This project builds an image classification model to identify whether an image belongs to a cat, dog, or panda using transfer learning with ResNet18 in PyTorch. We leverage a pre-trained model on ImageNet and fine-tune its final layers to adapt it for this 3-class classification task.
